mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances despite FEDFUNDS rising >0.5% over the horizon, or the IC exceeds 0.05 in a 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, it compresses equity discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS >4.5% in >50% of triggered instances, or IC <0.03 over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment below 4.0% strengthens labor market confidence, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite UNRATE <4.0% in >60% of triggered instances, or the IC exceeds 0.05 over the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) signal robust economic activity, leading to increased equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >5% and HOUST rises >10% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite both proxies rising above thresholds in >70% of instances, or the IC <0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) simultaneously indicate healthy economic growth, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >3% and INDPRO rises >5% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite both proxies rising above thresholds in >60% of instances, or IC <0.05 over the 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0%, signaling accelerating inflation, the Federal Reserve may raise rates, compressing equity discount rates and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL >2.0% in >50% of triggered instances, or IC >0.04 over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in PAYEMS (employment) above 140,000 signifies a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite PAYEMS >140000 in >70% of triggered instances, or IC <0.03 over the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.0% signals easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite FEDFUNDS <4.0% in >60% of late-cycle instances, or IC <0.05 over the 20-day window.
